summary: Detect which fixture files changed since last scan
description: Compare current file modification timestamps or content hashes against a stored last-scanned record and return the paths that changed.
scope: Inputs are in-memory dicts of path -> mtime or hash, not a live watcher
Return a list of paths whose values differ or are new
Return an empty list when every path matches
acceptanceCriteria: changed_files(record, current) returns tests/fixtures/simple_test.robot when only that file's stamp differs, and returns [] when stamps match.
constraints: Strict TDD: write the failing test first and run it before implementation.
Do not add UI, watcher, or CLI code unless this task explicitly requires it.
Do not apply incremental node updates yet.
Do not start a real filesystem watcher.
